# D2 results summary (generated by experiments/analyze.py)

Each value is the mean over the repetitions. Latency is the time a client waited for a full reply, including retries.

## Scenarios

| Scenario | What happens |
|---|---|
| E1 low | Equal servers, low load (8 client threads) |
| E1 medium | Equal servers, medium load (16 client threads) |
| E1 high | Equal servers, high load (32 client threads) |
| E2 unequal | Unequal servers: h1 fast (20 ms), h2 50 ms, h3 slow (150 ms) |
| E3 overload | Server overload: extra heavy traffic sent straight to h1 from 5 s to 15 s |
| E4 net load | Network load: h1's link flooded with bulk traffic from 5 s to 15 s |
| E5 crash | Server failure: h2's server process killed at 7 s, restarted at 14 s |
| E6 link down | Link failure: h3's link down at 7 s, back up at 14 s |

## Adaptive compared with round robin

Positive = adaptive is better.

| Scenario | Avg latency | p95 latency | Throughput |
|---|---|---|---|
| E1 low | -5% | -5% | -3% |
| E1 medium | -5% | -8% | -4% |
| E1 high | +1% | +1% | +1% |
| E2 unequal | +51% | +65% | +102% |
| E3 overload | +22% | +80% | +29% |
| E4 net load | +10% | +27% | +8% |
| E5 crash | -1% | +39% | +11% |
| E6 link down | +13% | -17% | +35% |

## How fast the controller noticed each event

Measured from the controller's event log (mean over repetitions; '-' means not detected).

| Scenario | Event | Mode | Controller event | Detected after (s) | Reason logged |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| E3 overload | hog_start | Adaptive (SDN) | h1 overloaded | 0.45 | queue 15 > 2.0 x 4 workers |
| E3 overload | hog_start | Static round robin | h1 overloaded | 0.47 | queue 18 > 2.0 x 4 workers |
| E4 net load | flood_start | Adaptive (SDN) | h1 overloaded | 1.40 | link 85% > 80% |
| E4 net load | flood_start | Static round robin | h1 overloaded | 1.49 | link 94% > 80% |
| E5 crash | server_kill | Adaptive (SDN) | h2 server_down | 0.01 | report connection closed |
| E5 crash | server_kill | Static round robin | h2 server_down | 0.02 | report connection closed |
| E5 crash | server_restart | Adaptive (SDN) | h2 server_up | 0.08 | load reports received |
| E5 crash | server_restart | Static round robin | h2 server_up | 0.08 | load reports received |
| E6 link down | link_down | Adaptive (SDN) | h3 server_down | 0.05 | switch port down |
| E6 link down | link_down | Static round robin | h3 server_down | 0.05 | switch port down |
| E6 link down | link_up | Adaptive (SDN) | h3 server_up | 0.27 | load reports received |
| E6 link down | link_up | Static round robin | h3 server_up | 0.33 | load reports received |

In round robin mode the controller still monitors and logs these events, but the static policy ignores them. Only adaptive mode acts on them: a failed server gets no new connections and its flow rules are deleted; an overloaded server's cost is tripled, so new connections go elsewhere unless every server is busy.
